title: Investment Property
summary: Prescribes accounting for investment property — recognising, measuring (current value model by default, with an historical-cost option forproperties that cannot be measured reliably), transferring the asset, and the linked-liability exception. Effective 1 January 2008.
description: IPSAS 16 Investment Property prescribes the accounting treatment for investment property, including the current value (fair value) model, the historical cost option, and transfers into or out of investment property.
